title: View transaction payload information
description: Implement queryTransaction API call from ledger.   1) capture transaction validation code into transactions table. Save the text, not the int, look at https://github.com/hyperledger/fabric/blob/v1.0.0/protos/peer/transaction.proto#L125 for txValidationCode enum.  2) There are byte arrays in the json response. One for the signature of the entity that signed the transaction, then there is one for chaincode_proposal_payload.input, and then there is one for the endorser signature. Can we convert to text and capture this info too in the database? If yes, then add these fields to the transactions details model.
